text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan conquers the Shuka Sho! 
Everyone remembered her presence and 
reaffirmed her exceptional talent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Aston Machan thought to 
herself: Just having Daiwa Scarlet and 
Vodka clash skyrockets the expectations 
for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, they wanted to make even more 
headlines than those two. First, a 
memorable run at the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen! Together with her Trainer, she 
fired herself up.
